quest_template_locale.LogDescription: Empower yourself with Unstable Holy Energy by defeating Wraths of the Light or siphoning from Breaches of Holy Energy around the foundation of the Nexus.
quest_template_locale.QuestDescription:
The energy from Light's Wrath lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault.  We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

quest_template_locale.LogDescription: Empower yourself with Unstable Arcane Energy by defeating Arcane Aberrants or siphoning from Breaches of Arcane Energy around the foundation of the Nexus.
quest_template_locale.QuestDescription:
The energy from Aluneth lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault.  We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.
